name: pi-slim
description: Terminal UX for Pi: slim status chrome, desktop notifications, Kitty session save/restore, clipboard cleaning, notes, pp/ppp launcher.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test test.mjs && node notify/test/notify.cjs && python3 -B notify/test/notify.py && node notify/test/gnome-notification-limit.cjs && python3 -B notify/test/kitty-save-session.py && (cd note && node --test note.test.mjs && python3 -B kitty_notes_test.py) && python3 -B clip/test_clipclean.py && python3 -B -m unittest -q ppp/test_shortcuts.py

author: superresistant
